cards.example_en: I found my lost ruler under the desk after everyone had left.
cards.example_zh: 大家都走了以后，我在书桌底下找到了丢失的尺子。

cards.example_en: The final race will determine this year's team winner.
cards.example_zh: 最后一场比赛将决定今年的团体冠军。

cards.example_en: Dirty boots were left outside so the kitchen floor stayed clean.
cards.example_zh: 脏靴子放在门外，厨房地板才保持干净。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：迪斯科舞厅
cards.example_en: They went to a disco on Saturday.
cards.example_zh: 他们星期六去了迪斯科舞厅。

cards.example_en: A cold wind pushed the door shut while we were carrying boxes.
cards.example_zh: 我们搬箱子的时候，冷风把门带上了。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：在楼下

cards.example_en: The postcard from Egypt shows pyramids under a very blue sky.
cards.example_zh: 从埃及寄来的明信片上，金字塔衬着很蓝的天空。

cards.example_en: The empty bottle rolled under the seat during the bus ride.
cards.example_zh: 空瓶子在乘公交时滚到了座位底下。

cards.example_en: We need to evaluate the results of the test.
cards.example_zh: 我们需要评估测试结果。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：非凡的
cards.example_en: An extraordinary comet was visible from our balcony last night.
cards.example_zh: 昨晚从我们的阳台能看见一颗非凡的彗星。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：同伴的
cards.example_en: She lent a tissue to her fellow passenger on the crowded train.
cards.example_zh: 她在拥挤的火车上把纸巾借给了同行的乘客。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：平坦的
cards.example_en: The flat field behind the school is perfect for flying kites.
cards.example_zh: 学校后面那块平地非常适合放风筝。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：地板；楼层
cards.example_en: Soup spilled across the kitchen floor during dinner.
cards.example_zh: 晚饭时汤洒在了厨房的地板上。

cards.example_en: We bought some new furniture for the bedroom.
cards.example_zh: 我们为卧室买了一些新家具。

cards.example_en: Bikes and a spare tyre fill the garage behind the house.
cards.example_zh: 自行车和一只备用轮胎塞满了屋后的车库。
